verdict.rationale: Ente's own help site has a self-hosting guide that walks users through running Ente Auth on their own machine (`localhost:3003`). Ente also states that its apps and server are open source, and a community comment confirms the open-source release. missing for 10: detailed self-hosting setup and server configuration steps in the evidence, independent hands-on reports of self-hosting Auth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
